title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen coding model
summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, an execution model for code writing and agent tasks featuring configurable reasoning levels and multi-model Antigravity orchestration.
research_notes:
Select Gemini 4 Hydrogen (model ID gemini-4-hydrogen) in Google AI Studio or the Gemini API for execution-oriented development tasks.

Configure the thinking level between low, medium, high, and xhigh depending on the balance of latency and reasoning depth required.

Enable Orchestrator mode in Google Antigravity to pair Gemini 4 Carbon for architectural planning with Gemini 4 Hydrogen for iterative code generation and testing.

Use Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a high-speed execution engine for repository tasks like boilerplate generation, unit tests, and refactoring while delegating high-level architectural decisions to frontier planning models.

Keep default high thinking depth for non-trivial coding tasks to maintain reasoning quality while preserving quota and execution speed.
